softwareInnerHero.title: Transform How Your Teams Collaborate
paragraphs: Autodesk BIM Collaborate Pro is a cloud-based construction collaboration platform designed to connect design and construction teams, enabling real-time project coordination, review, and data management.

By providing a centralized common data environment (CDE), BIM Collaborate Pro breaks down silos between disciplines, giving all stakeholders access to the latest models, drawings, and project documents.
Its advanced coordination, clash detection, and communication tools help teams identify and resolve issues early, reducing costly rework and improving overall project efficiency.

Integrated with the Autodesk Construction Cloud, BIM Collaborate Pro ensures seamless workflows from design to construction and handover, supporting better decision-making, consistent data management, and successful project delivery across every stage of the construction lifecycle.

cardSections.subheading: Discover the capabilities that make BIM Collaborate Pro the industry standard

items.title: Cloud-Based Collaboration
items.body: Access project data anytime, anywhere with a secure cloud platform that supports real-time collaboration across teams and locations.

items.title: Model Coordination
items.body: Automatically detect clashes between models from different disciplines and assign issues to team members for resolution.

items.title: Issue Tracking
items.body: Track issues from identification to resolution with customizable workflows, assignments, and due dates to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

items.title: Document Management
items.body: Centralize all project documents with version control, approval workflows, and access permissions to ensure everyone works from the latest information.

items.title: Design Review
items.body: Review models and drawings with markup tools, comments, and real-time discussions to capture feedback and decisions.

items.title: Reporting & Analytics
items.body: Generate reports on project status, issue resolution, and team performance to identify trends and improve processes.
